summary: Between February 19 and 25, 2026 an unauthorized third party accessed and copied files from the systems of Fourteen Foods, a Franklin, Tennessee operator of Dairy Queen Grill & Chill restaurants in several states, which was alerted to suspicious activity on February 23. After a review completed September 10, the company notified affected individuals in October 2026 that names and Social Security numbers were involved, and offered credit monitoring; the count was not disclosed.
